title: Preparing approximate $N$-fold cat states with the phase space instruction set
summary: The phase space instruction set is a continuous-variable universal gate set involving single-qubit rotations and qubit-dependent displacements on a single boson. Using these gates, we prove that a circuit depth $\mathrmΩ(\varphi(N))$ is necessary to approximately prepare a large $N$-fold rotationally invariant Schrödinger cat state; here $\varphi(N) \gtrsim N/\log\log N$ is the Euler totient function.
